definitions.segment_intervals: expected_output_interval is requested output placement; actual_output_interval is its intersection with the retained output string (possibly empty)
definitions.processing_model: as_is preserves every symbol; reverse_complement uses frozen explicit_sequence_view_v1 DNA/RNA complements with case preservation; U and T complement to A; the model does not establish input identity

source_coverage.calculation: group by exact (subject_ref,unit); union intervals for distinct_source_position_count; sum lengths for source_position_occurrence_count; subtract distinct from occurrences for repeated_source_position_count
source_coverage.unit: each group's original nt, aa or symbol; never pooled across identities or units
source_coverage.missing: null when the relevant path is unavailable; no original source sequence or total length is inferred

definitions.three_unit_ancestry: units_per_symbol=3 maps one protein output symbol to three original nt or unspecified source symbols, including split intervals; output-symbol counts stay separate
definitions.original_source_validation_limit: parent_mapping is explicitly supplied by the host; source contents, lengths and identity bindings cannot be independently reacquired or verified from this mapping alone
